subject: Missed callbacks & SLA acknowledgement — Aurion <> Redwood connector
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@auriontech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurion Integrations <integrations@auriontech.com>
Date: 2026-12-09T16:12:00Z
Subject: Missed callbacks — our ingestion is delayed (urgent)

Hi Grace,

We started seeing a spike in missed callbacks from the Redwood connector starting ~2026-12-09 08:00 PT. Events are queued on our side but your webhook endpoint is returning intermittent 5xx/timeout responses. Over the last 36 hours we've missed ~1.8k order updates; this is impacting downstream billing reconciliation.

Sample failed callback: event_id=aur-evt-20261209-7981, timestamp=2026-12-09T09:23:11-08:00, HTTP status=504.

I've attached the aurion_webhook_log_20261209.txt with a short sample of traces. Can you confirm SLA acknowledgement and next steps? We need an escalation path and an ETA for a fix or mitigation (temporary replay/backfill).

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Integrations — Aurion Technologies
Attachments: aurion_webhook_log_20261209.txt
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@auriontech.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T16:28:00Z
Subject: Re: Missed callbacks — our ingestion is delayed (urgent)

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads-up and for sending the logs. Acknowledged.

Quick plan of action from our side:
- Immediate: open an incident bridge and confirm point-of-contact. Rafael will lead triage.
- Short-term mitigation: we can enable a limited burst window and a temporary replay endpoint so you can push queued events while we investigate.
- Next update: within 2 hours with triage findings; full RCA/ETA within 48 hours.

Can you confirm a phone number for the on-call engineer and whether you can provide the full drive folder link for all logs? I attached our initial_triage_checklist.pdf so you can see what we'll try first.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Partner Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: initial_triage_checklist.pdf

Subject: SUP-2345 — Aurion missed callbacks: escalation & SLA window

Hi all,

I've opened an internal support ticket: SUP-2345 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-2345). Summary of our escalation plan and commitments:
- Incident severity: P1 (customer impact to billing reconciliation).
- Initial acknowledgement: within 1 hour (this thread).
- Mitigation window: we'll open a temporary replay endpoint and increase burst capacity to 10 req/s for a 6-hour mitigation window if Aurion confirms. Please note this is a controlled change and will be rolled back after the window.
- Ownership: Rafael Mendes (triage/patch), Marcus Lin (runtime and rate-limiting).
- ETA for root-cause analysis: initial findings within 12 hours, full RCA within 48 hours.

Action items for Aurion: confirm you want the 6-hour burst window now and add Melanie Porter to the bridge (melanie@auriontech.com).

We'll stand up a Webex bridge in 10 minutes — link: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-12-10-aurion-001

Rafael Mendes
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference

Thanks Rafael — we confirm the 6-hour burst window and ask that you open the replay endpoint now. Melanie will join the bridge (melanie@auriontech.com, +1-415-555-0192).

We've uploaded additional logs to the Drive folder. From our triage, the sequence looks like: short-term spikes in latency (200-500ms) followed by occasional 504s; our retries then hit 429s for a short period which amplified the backlog.

Please proceed and keep the SUP-2345 ticket updated with timestamps for when the replay endpoint goes live and when the window will be closed. We'll coordinate the backfill from our side.

Sanjay Rao
Head of Integrations — Aurion Technologies
